_about: Recorded judge verdicts for src/eval/cases.ts, one per case id: the SKU the judge picks from the candidate list, or null for none. HAND-WRITTEN in the build session, not recorded from a model (no API key was available): each verdict imitates a careful judge that sees only the customer's line and the candidate list (SKU, description, pack). Re-record with the real judge once one exists and a key is set.

m01-box-12x10x8.reason: 12x10x8 single wall 32 ECT is the standard equivalent of 200 lb test, and it comes in bundles of 25 as asked.

m02-box-12x10x6.reason: 12x10x6, 200# test is the 32 ECT grade, 25 per bundle.

m04-box-kraft-10x8x6.reason: Plain (kraft) 10x8x6 32 ECT box; the white one is a different item.

m07-hd-16-cube.reason: Heavy duty 16x16x16, BC flute is double wall.

m08-gaylord-tw.reason: Triple wall gaylord 48x40x36; both listings are this gaylord at different pricing tiers.
